title: TcArchiveRecord
description: One line of tc/archive/<YYYY>/<MM>/forecasts.jsonl (docs/tc.md section 8.2): one forecast of one numbered storm by one source. That basin is the id's, that forecast is an ensemble exactly when kind is, and the forecast's own rules (docs/tc.md section 7) are the readers' own checks.

name.description: The name the source gave, or null.

origin.description: Where the record came from: the hourly product, or a backfill.

forecast.description: A tc-storm forecast track, or a member set when kind is ensemble.
